name: Amahara Ibito
source:
Ibito is a high school student who, even though he claims that he is normal, can be compared to a bishojo game protagonist with all his stats maxed out.

Especially in his recent days, Ibito's total body strength has increased abnormally and he has become able to perform superhuman feats. Even so, the only thing he is interested in are computer games.
